nodes.label: CSKB Alternatives Considered
nodes.rationale: ChromaDB/Qdrant/Weaviate rejected as default (extra service, pluggable via CSKB_STORE=chroma); Postgres+pgvector rejected (heavyweight); Neo4j rejected (overlaps with graphify-out, keep for local code graph); cloud-only rejected (breaks local-first promise); fine-tuning-only rejected (RAG stays current and citable).

nodes.label: cs kb CLI
nodes.rationale: Commands: cs kb ingest, cs kb query, cs kb export-dataset, cs kb refresh.

nodes.label: CSKB Platform Principles Compliance
nodes.rationale: AI reasons, tools execute; KB exposed as a port (KBSearch capability); plugins return structured data only (KBChunk); all output must normalize (KBContextExcerpt); apps never call plugins directly (only via ContextBuilder).

nodes.label: ContextBuilder Integration
nodes.rationale: KB retriever opt-in per AI call (request.use_kb: bool) so cost stays predictable; builds FindingContextPayload with kb_excerpts.

nodes.label: CSKB Sibling Docker Image
nodes.rationale: AI Gateway must reason over a deep curated EXTERNAL corpus of cybersecurity knowledge (not just findings from a single scan) to become the most expertise-rich AI-first platform; packaged as reusable sibling Docker image so other agents, fine-tuning pipelines, and LLM components can reuse the same KB. Working name astraix/cskb:latest.

nodes.label: cybersec_kb Python Package
nodes.rationale: Package with ingest/, retriever/, api/, cli.py, sdk.py; SDK consumable by ai_gateway/ via from cybersec_kb import Retriever.

nodes.rationale: Tier 1 curated knowledge bases, Tier 2 AI-for-cybersecurity, Tier 3 standards bodies (OWASP + GitHub topics).

nodes.label: SQLite + FTS5 + sqlite-vec Storage
nodes.rationale: Single-file SQLite with FTS5 + sqlite-vec vector index; one DB file = one KB; zero external services; pluggable via CSKB_STORE=chroma.

nodes.label: CSKB Trade-offs
nodes.rationale: Pro: massive expertise boost, reusable, single-binary SQLite, pluggable embeddings, local-first, doubles as fine-tuning env. Con: larger image (~4GB), license attribution complexity, re-embed on schema change, slow first-run ingest (5-15 min), no multi-tenant isolation.

nodes.label: Training Dataset Export
nodes.rationale: cs kb export-dataset --format jsonl rows {prompt, response, source_repo, source_url} safe for instruction fine-tuning; image ships torch/transformers/peft/datasets/accelerate.

nodes.label: AstraIX Security Analyst Platform
nodes.rationale: AI-powered autonomous VAPT platform spawning real Kali Linux containers via Docker socket to execute actual security tools, normalize findings, score risk, and provide AI-generated executive summaries.

nodes.label: astraix-kali Image
nodes.rationale: Custom Kali image with tools pre-installed (NOT kalilinux/kali-rolling:latest which has zero tools).

nodes.label: Cybersecurity Knowledge Base
nodes.rationale: 360+ sources, TF-IDF search; lives INSIDE Docker in named volume kb-data mounted at /app/knowledge-base so host AV (Bitdefender) cannot delete/quarantine it; seeded by docker/entrypoint.sh when embeddings/chunks.json is missing.

nodes.label: ReconOrchestrator
nodes.rationale: Parallel tool execution in 3 phases: recon -> web -> deep.

nodes.label: VAPT Scan Route Handler (route.ts)
nodes.rationale: Next.js rewrite proxy had ~30s timeout that killed long-running (~44s) VAPT scans; Route Handler proxies server-side with 180s AbortController timeout and takes precedence over afterFiles rewrites.

nodes.label: Docker SDK Dependency
nodes.rationale: docker>=7.1.0 replaces subprocess docker calls.

nodes.label: Backend Service (astraix-backend)
nodes.rationale: Runs as root with Docker socket mounted; VAPT_USE_DOCKER=true, VAPT_DEMO_MODE=false; LLM via OLLAMA_BASE_URL (host.docker.internal:11434) or NVIDIA NIM.

nodes.label: kb-data Named Volume
nodes.rationale: Knowledge base lives in Docker-managed named volume seeded from baked image copy on first boot, NOT on host filesystem, so host antivirus/file sync cannot delete or quarantine it.

nodes.label: LLM Provider Config
nodes.rationale: LLM_PROVIDER default ollama; AI_MODEL default deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro via NVIDIA NIM (integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1); OLLAMA_MODEL huihui_ai/qwen2.5-abliterate:7b-instruct.

nodes.label: Neo4j Service (neo4j:5)
nodes.rationale: Attack surface correlation; auth none, 512M pagecache, 1G heap.

nodes.label: Nginx Reverse Proxy Service
